lesson.title: Finding Items and Checking Out Smoothly at the Supermarket

concept.name_en: Polite Requests for Help in Aisles
concept.name_zh: 在超市货架请求帮助的礼貌表达
concept.explanation_zh: 在超市购物时，如果找不到某件商品，礼貌地向工作人员请求帮助非常重要。使用委婉的表达方式，比如“Could you please tell me where...?”或者“Would you mind showing me where...?”，能让沟通更顺畅，也显示尊重对方。避免直接命令式的语气，这样更容易得到积极的回应。
examples: Could you please tell me where the gluten-free bread is?
Would you mind showing me where the organic vegetables are?
Excuse me, do you know which aisle has the almond milk?
concept.common_mistake_zh: 很多学习者直接说“Where is the...?”，这听起来不够礼貌。更好的是说“Could you please tell me where...?”，这样更自然也更礼貌。

vocabulary.pronunciation_tip_zh: ‘refrigerated’重音在第二个音节，‘section’重音在第一个音节，连读自然
vocabulary.explain_in_english: The refrigerated section is where cold items like milk and cheese are kept in a store.
vocabulary.usage_note_zh: 常用于超市环境，正式和非正式都适用。
examples: The milk is in the refrigerated section.
Please check the refrigerated section for fresh salads.

vocabulary.explain_in_english: To stock up on something means to buy a large amount to have enough for a while.
vocabulary.usage_note_zh: 购物或准备时常用，适合口语和书面语。
examples: I need to stock up on snacks for the party.
People often stock up on supplies before a storm.

vocabulary.pronunciation_tip_zh: ‘bagging’重音在第一个音节，‘area’重音在第一个音节，连读自然
vocabulary.meaning_zh: 装袋区，结账后装购物袋的地方
vocabulary.explain_in_english: The bagging area is where customers put their items into bags after paying.
vocabulary.usage_note_zh: 购物结账时常用，适合所有购物环境。
examples: Please place your items in the bagging area.
The bagging area is right next to the checkout counter.

scene.title: Asking for a Hard-to-Find Item and Checking Out
scene.context_zh: 在超市里找一个难找的商品，并顺利完成结账。
scene.script_en:
Customer: Excuse me, could you please tell me where the gluten-free pasta is? I’ve looked everywhere but can’t find it.
Employee: Of course! You’ll find it in aisle 7, just next to the organic sauces.
Customer: Thank you so much! Also, do you happen to have almond milk? I don’t see it in the dairy section.
Employee: Yes, almond milk is in the refrigerated section, aisle 4. I can show you if you want.
Customer: That would be great, thanks for your help!
Employee: No problem at all. If you need assistance with anything else, just let me know.

Customer (at checkout): Hi, just these items today.
Cashier: Did you find everything you were looking for?
Customer: Yes, thank you! By the way, I saw a sign about a discount on cereals. Is it still available?
Cashier: Yes, if you buy two boxes, you get 10% off the total price.
Customer: Perfect! I’ll take one more box then.
Cashier: Your total comes to $23.45.
Customer: Here you go. Thanks for your help!
Cashier: You’re welcome! Have a great day and thanks for shopping with us.
scene.translation_zh:
顾客：打扰一下，请问无麸质意大利面在哪里？我找遍了都没找到。
店员：当然！在7号货架，就在有机酱料旁边。
顾客：非常感谢！还有，你们有杏仁奶吗？我在乳制品区没看到。
店员：有的，杏仁奶在冷藏区，4号货架。如果你愿意，我可以带你去。
顾客：太好了，谢谢你的帮助！
店员：一点问题都没有。如果你还需要帮助，随时告诉我。

顾客（结账时）：您好，今天就买这些。
收银员：您找到所有想买的东西了吗？
顾客：找到了，谢谢！顺便问一下，我看到麦片有折扣，还有效吗？
收银员：有效，买两盒能打九折。
顾客：太好了，那我再买一盒。
收银员：总共是23.45美元。
顾客：给您，谢谢你的帮助！
收银员：不客气！祝您有美好的一天，谢谢光临。
scene.practice_tip_zh: 练习用礼貌句型询问货架位置，多记购物相关词汇和短语，这会让你在超市购物时更自信。

reading.title: How Politeness Made My Supermarket Trip Easier
reading.text_en:
Last weekend, I went to the supermarket with a short list: pasta, milk, and fresh vegetables. While walking through the aisles, I remembered my friend needs gluten-free pasta. I wasn’t sure where to find it, so I politely asked a store employee, "Could you please tell me where the gluten-free pasta is?" She kindly pointed me to aisle 7, right next to the organic sauces. I was relieved to find it quickly.

Then, I wanted to get almond milk for my friend. I looked in the dairy aisle but didn’t see any almond milk. I asked another staff member, "Would you mind showing me where the almond milk is?" She smiled and led me to the refrigerated section in aisle 4. I appreciated how easy it was to get help when I asked politely.

At the checkout counter, I noticed a sign about a discount on cereal. I asked the cashier, "Is there a discount on this cereal?" He said yes, if I bought two boxes. That was a nice surprise! I decided to buy an extra box. The cashier was friendly and thanked me warmly as I paid.

This trip reminded me how important polite communication is. Asking for help with respect makes shopping easier and creates a pleasant atmosphere. Next time, I will remember to use polite phrases and check price tags carefully to avoid surprises. I also plan to stock up on some favorite snacks for future visits and hope to explore new items in the refrigerated section. Shopping feels less stressful when I know I can ask for help politely and get good advice.
reading.summary_zh: 作者讲述了在超市购物时，如何通过礼貌地向店员询问商品位置和折扣，顺利买到需要的东西，强调了礼貌沟通的重要性。还提到计划囤积零食，享受购物过程。

questions.question: What two items did the author ask store employees about?
Why did the author buy an extra box of cereal?
questions.answer: Because there was a discount if they bought two boxes.
